decks.notes: The key concept of this deck is to generate a large amount of red mana quickly using rituals and medallions in order to cast powerful spells like Ral, Monsoon Mage and Past in Flames multiple times in a single turn. By chaining together spells and utilizing cards like Wish and Glimpse the Impossible, the deck aims to create explosive combos to overwhelm the opponent and win the game in a single turn. The deck focuses on speed, efficiency, and synergy to execute its game plan effectively and consistently.

The deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful creatures like Griselbrand using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Tainted Indulgence. It also utilizes cards like Ephemerate and Faithful Mending to protect and dig through the deck, as well as disruption cards like Prismatic Ending and Force of Negation to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The goal is to combine these elements to create a fast and resilient combo deck that can overwhelm the opponent and win the game with powerful creatures while also having interaction and protection against opposing threats.

The deck focuses on tutoring for and assembling a variety of creature-based combos using cards like Chord of Calling and Summoner's Pact. It utilizes creatures with versatile abilities such as Springheart Nantuko and Nadu, Winged Wisdom to create a toolbox approach to dealing with different situations. The deck also includes utility lands like Horizon Canopy and Yavimaya, Cradle of Growth to support the combo pieces. By efficiently using creatures and spells to find the right answers, the deck aims to outmaneuver opponents and secure victory through synergistic interactions.

The main focus of this deck is to generate as much mana as possible through cards like Desperate Ritual, Manamorphose, and Ruby Medallion in order to cast big spells like Past in Flames and Ral, Monsoon Mage. By chaining together rituals and card draw effects, the deck aims to quickly assemble a powerful combo turn that can deal a large amount of damage to the opponent. Additionally, the inclusion of Wish allows for additional flexibility in accessing key combo pieces from the sideboard to further enhance the deck's explosive potential.

The deck focuses on aggressive gameplay, utilizing a mix of creatures and spells to deal damage quickly to the opponent. It heavily relies on the synergy between Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding to control the opponent's board while building up its own. The deck also features a mix of strong creatures such as Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Territorial Kavu, along with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames to finish off the opponent. The inclusion of Scion of Draco provides a powerful late-game threat to close out the match.

The deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures with abilities that can be used in combination to create a powerful toolbox of options. By utilizing cards like Chord of Calling and Urza's Saga, the deck can quickly search for and deploy the necessary creatures to control the board and ultimately win the game. The deck also includes a mix of lands and support cards to provide additional utility and protection for the combo pieces. The key strategy is to efficiently and effectively use the creatures to outmaneuver and overwhelm the opponent.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays using a combination of creatures with powerful abilities and spells to control the board and deal damage quickly. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion allows for a unique mana source and adds flexibility to the deck's strategy. By utilizing cards like Galvanic Discharge, Guide of Souls, and Ob Nixilis, the Adversary, the deck can apply pressure early and maintain board presence. Additionally, cards like Static Prison and Thoughtseize help disrupt the opponent's game plan, allowing the deck to maintain its tempo and secure victory.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells and removal while using powerful creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Solitude to maintain board control. The One Ring serves as a key centerpiece, providing card advantage and additional control elements. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while slowly building up its own resources to dominate the late game. With a mix of control elements, card advantage, and powerful threats, this deck seeks to outlast and outmaneuver its opponents in a battle of attrition.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying threats and disrupting the opponent's game plan with a mix of aggressive creatures and efficient counter spells. By deploying threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Murktide Regent early in the game, the deck aims to apply pressure to the opponent. The deck also includes a variety of counter spells like Counterspell and Force of Negation to protect its threats and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Additionally, cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration help filter through the deck to find the needed cards to maintain pressure and control the game.

The deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower) to generate large amounts of mana quickly. It utilizes control elements such as Thought-Knot Seer and Karn, the Great Creator to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Devourer of Destiny and Eldrazi creatures provide threats that can quickly close out the game. The inclusion of Ugin, the Spirit Dragon and All Is Dust allows for board wipes to stabilize against aggressive decks. The key strategy is to control the game early and then ramp up to powerful late-game threats.

This deck focuses on using the combo potential of Underworld Breach alongside cards that allow for increased card draw, mana ramp, and library manipulation. By looping spells and using Twiddle effects, the deck aims to generate infinite mana and cast multiple spells in a single turn. Consign to Memory and Wish provide versatility while Hidden Strings and Dream's Grip offer additional untap abilities. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces quickly and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful sequence of spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing creatures with various abilities to assemble a powerful combo and toolbox strategy. It aims to sacrifice and recur creatures, generate mana, and control the board through a mix of graveyard interaction and creature abilities. The deck utilizes cards like Young Wolf, Yawgmoth, Thran Physician, and Chord of Calling to create synergistic plays and overwhelm the opponent with a versatile and adaptable game plan. The strategy revolves around creating value and leveraging creature abilities to achieve victory.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on creating a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Amped Raptor to deal quick damage to the opponent. The deck also incorporates cards like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge for additional direct damage, while utilizing Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ocelot Pride for additional power and board control. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional mana flexibility and support for the aggressive strategy, making it a versatile and potent deck in Modern 1 vs 1 matchups.

The main concept of this Mono Black Control deck is to efficiently control the game by utilizing a combination of removal spells, discard spells, and powerful creatures. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek, while also providing resilient threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Boggart Trawler. The deck also includes ways to gain advantage through card draw with Necrodominance and Soul Spike. Overall, the deck focuses on maintaining control of the board and out-valuing the opponent to secure victory.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game by using counterspells, removal spells, and powerful enchantments like The One Ring and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also generating card advantage and setting up win conditions through card selection and card draw. It utilizes a mix of control elements such as counterspells, removal, and card advantage to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent. The deck focuses on controlling the board and maintaining a strong presence to eventually overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

The deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures with unique abilities to combo off and win the game. It utilizes cards like Chord of Calling and Summoner's Pact to tutor for specific creatures needed for the situation. The deck also includes various support cards like Shuko and Springheart Nantuko to enable the combo pieces. The inclusion of cards like Urza's Saga and Boseiju, Who Endures provide additional utility and protection for the combo. The deck aims to find the right creatures at the right time to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.
